name: CR-15 Multi-Purpose Crystalliser
summary: Liquid sealer-crystalliser that gives marble and terrazzo floors a hard, glossy finish.
description:
CR-15 seals and crystallises marble and terrazzo floors in one step. It also brings up the shine on natural granite and is suited to the upkeep of porcelain tile, quartz and engineered stone.

Shake well and use it neat, never diluted or mixed. Spray a little onto a small area, spread it with a polishing machine fitted with a steel wool pad, and work it until completely dry. Move on area by area until the whole floor is done.
features: Seals and crystallises in one step
For marble, terrazzo, granite, porcelain, quartz and engineered stone
Used neat, straight from the container

specs.label: Application
specs.value: Floor machine with steel wool pad

specs.label: Coverage
specs.value: About 40 ml per 2 m² per pass

name: AB-10-B Metallising Varnish (Gloss)
summary: Self-shining emulsion that dries to a hard, glossy protective layer.
description:
AB-10-B is a self-shining finish for natural stone, terrazzo, slate, terracotta, wood, cork and plastic floors. No buffing is needed: it dries to a hard, shiny coat that protects the surface.

Apply it to a clean floor that has been stripped and fully dried. Spread it neat in straight, even lines with a sponge or wax applicator, not in circles. Let it dry, then apply a second coat at right angles to the first.
features: Self-shining, no buffing
Hard, protective gloss film
For stone, terrazzo, slate, terracotta, wood, cork and plastic floors

specs.label: Coats
specs.value: 2, the second at right angles to the first

specs.label: Preparation
specs.value: Strip, rinse and dry the floor first

name: Floor Polishing Pads (5-Step)
summary: Five-step diamond pads that polish and maintain floors using only water.
description: The DCM floor pads keep floors at a high gloss all year without polishing chemicals. Work through the five steps in order, using water only. They fit standard floor machines, so no special equipment or specialist contractor is needed, and they cut the time spent on floor maintenance.
features: No chemicals: water only
Easy to use, no specialist needed
Works on machines you already have
Use wet or dry
Cuts maintenance time and labour

name: Single Disc Diamond Polisher 2.5 HP
summary: 430 mm single-disc machine for diamond polishing, buffing and scrubbing marble floors.
description: A heavy single-disc machine built for diamond polishing, buffing and scrubbing marble floors. It comes with brushes, a pad driver and extra weights for more pressure when grinding.
features: Diamond polishing, buffing and scrubbing
Supplied with brushes, pad driver and extra weights
Runs on single-phase power

name: Floor Grinding Machine HSP-400
summary: 400 mm planetary grinder for grinding and polishing smaller marble, granite and concrete areas.
description: The HSP-400 has a planetary drive in an aluminium-alloy gearbox and variable speed through a frequency drive. It suits grinding and polishing smaller areas of marble, granite and concrete. The handle folds and the machine separates for easy transport. A vacuum connection allows dust-free work.
features: Planetary drive for an even finish
Variable speed
Folds and separates for transport
Vacuum connection for dust-free work

name: Floor Grinder Scarifier SP250
summary: Heavy-duty scarifier that strips coatings and prepares concrete for epoxy and PU floors.
description: The SP250 uses a fast-spinning drum of cutters to mill the floor surface. It removes old coatings, adhesives, paint, line markings and surface contamination, and prepares concrete before epoxy, polyurethane and other floor coatings are laid. The drum can be changed to suit different jobs and surfaces.
features: Removes coatings, adhesives, paint and line markings
Prepares concrete for epoxy and PU coatings
Interchangeable drum

name: TRUKOLOR Colour Enhancer
summary: Penetrating sealer that deepens natural stone colour and protects against water, dirt and stains.
description: TRUKOLOR soaks into natural stone to deepen its colour and bring out its veining and texture. It suits granite, slate, limestone, travertine and other natural stone. It protects against water, dirt and stains, and it resists UV and weather, so it can be used indoors and outdoors: patios, walkways, countertops, pool decks and fireplaces. The stone can still breathe, which helps prevent efflorescence and damage from trapped moisture.
features: Deepens colour and brings out veining
Protects against water, dirt and stains
UV and weather resistant, for indoor and outdoor use
Breathable: lets moisture vapour escape

specs.label: Stones
specs.value: Granite, slate, limestone, travertine and other natural stone

name: STAINEX Floor Sealer
summary: Impregnating sealer that protects natural stone against water- and oil-based stains.
description:
STAINEX soaks into natural stone and protects it against both water- and oil-based stains, while repelling water and dirt. The stone can still breathe, and the sealer is UV resistant.

Apply it to a clean, dry surface. Test a small patch first, because some stones darken slightly. Apply 2 to 3 even coats with a brush, roller, sprayer or lint-free cloth, and wipe off any surplus. Keep it away from direct sun and moisture while it cures. In food areas, ventilate for 2 to 3 days.
features: Protects against water- and oil-based stains
Water and dirt repellent
Breathable and UV resistant

specs.label: Curing
specs.value: Repels water within minutes, fully cured in 12 to 24 hours

specs.label: Application
specs.value: Brush, roller, sprayer or lint-free cloth

name: Sandstone Sealer WZ
summary: Water-based deep-penetrating sealer that repels water and dirt on absorbent stone and concrete.
description:
A premium water-based sealer that soaks deep into absorbent surfaces such as sandstone, concrete, travertine, marble, granite and limestone, and repels water and dirt. It keeps the stone's natural look, lets moisture vapour escape and is UV resistant, for indoor and outdoor use.

It can also seal the underside of stone. Apply it at least 24 hours before laying to stop moisture rising through the stone. Apply 2 to 3 coats with a brush, roller, sponge or sprayer, and wipe off any extra.
features: Water-based, deep penetrating
Repels water and dirt, keeps the natural look
Breathable and UV resistant, for indoor and outdoor use
Also seals the underside of stone before laying

specs.label: Surfaces
specs.value: Sandstone, concrete, travertine, marble, granite, limestone

name: Z-Xtra Marble Crystallising Powder
summary: Crystallising powder that brings marble floors to a high-gloss finish.
description:
Mix Z-Xtra with water into a paste and work it into the wetted floor with a single-disc machine and red pad. Go across the floor one way, then at right angles. The gloss appears as the paste dries. Mist with water if it dries too quickly, then buff with a white pad for extra shine. Afterwards, wash the floor with Surie Polex Floor Cleaner Neutral and vacuum it dry.

Mix the paste just before use, protect nearby furniture and other floor types from splashes, wear gloves and boots, and store the powder dry.
features: High-gloss crystallised finish on marble
Applied with a standard single-disc machine
Mixed with water on site

specs.label: Pads
specs.value: Red pad to apply, white pad to finish

specs.label: After use
specs.value: Wash with Floor Cleaner Neutral and vacuum dry

name: SP-1 Liquid Crystalliser
summary: Spray crystalliser for the regular maintenance of marble and limestone floors.
description:
SP-1 gives marble and other calcareous stone a high gloss. Crystallising makes the floor harder-wearing and less sensitive to acids. It is also used to bring worn traffic lanes on previously crystallised floors back to a shine.

Spray sparingly and work it in with a single-disc machine and a steel wool or white pad until dry. Repeat once for more shine. Remove all pad residue afterwards with a damp mop or Surie Polex Floor Cleaner Neutral. For a deeper gloss, finish with a white pad on a high-speed burnisher.
features: High gloss on marble and limestone
Harder-wearing, less acid-sensitive floors
Restores shine in worn traffic lanes

specs.label: Dose
specs.value: Up to 2 to 3 sprays per m²

name: Gloex Granite Polishing Cream
summary: Wax-free cream polish that gives granite, vitrified and porcelain floors a brilliant shine.
description: Gloex Cream is a water-based cream polish with no wax. It reacts with the surface to produce the shine, and it seals the pores so dust builds up less. It can be used at the end of granite polishing, to revive old worn floors, or for routine maintenance.
features: Wax-free: the shine comes from reacting with the surface
Seals pores, so less dust builds up
For final polishing, renovation or regular maintenance

specs.label: Surfaces
specs.value: Granite, vitrified and porcelain tiles, quartz, green marble, sandstone
